name: webots
readme_excerpt: Webots: open-source robot simulator Webots provides a complete development environment to model, program, and simulate robots, vehicles, and mechanical systems. It is a beginner friendly software that is meant to introduce newcomers to the world of robotics. - See the Webots introduction video. - View online Webots simulations at webots.cloud.
